284083137.description:
Polished Crystal Obelisk Tower Lot
Decorative Mineral Points and Carved Stone Pillars
Set of 4 Pieces
A diverse assortment of four polished gemstone and mineral obelisk towers, featuring cut and polished faceted termination points with flat, freestanding bases. Crystal towers and standing obelisks are popular in modern interior decor, lapidary display collections, and holistic or meditation settings. Each piece showcases natural crystalline patterning, banding, and organic mineral color variations.
Items Included:
One large pale green crystalline obelisk tower with soft white veining
One medium chevron amethyst tower with deep violet and white quartz banding
One slender polished amethyst hexagonal wand point
One small dark smoky mineral crystal point
Condition:
Pre-owned in good display condition. Stone surfaces retain high-gloss polish across faceted sides. Natural internal fractures, crystalline inclusions, and minor raw surface fissures characteristic of natural geological specimens. Base edges show light contact wear, with one handwritten price marking on the underside of the medium amethyst point. Tips and facets remain well defined.
